## What the Numbers Show

- **Checking** a value for ASCII text with the .NET reference implementation's <xref:Singulink.Steno.StenoEncoding.IsAsciiText*> is measured against a plain copy of the same bytes; the table has its share of the copy's speed on a document and on 16-character values.
- **Converting** ASCII text between Steno and UTF-8 with the .NET reference implementation runs at the same speed in both directions, and several times as fast as decoding it to UTF-16 with <xref:Singulink.Steno.StenoEncoding.GetChars*>.

The .NET reference implementation converts other text between Steno and UTF-8 through UTF-16 inside the library, still without making a string.
